lines.en: Uma, the water finally went down. It had been raining for three days before the street flooded last night.
lines.pt: Uma, a água finalmente baixou. Estava chovendo havia três dias antes de a rua inundar ontem à noite.

lines.en: I know. I had been checking the drain every hour, but it was already blocked with leaves and mud by midnight.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Eu vinha verificando o bueiro toda hora, mas à meia-noite ele já estava bloqueado de folhas e lama.

lines.en: Experts had been warning us for years that the drains were too small. Nobody in the council took it seriously.
lines.pt: Especialistas vinham nos avisando havia anos que os bueiros eram pequenos demais. Ninguém na prefeitura levou a sério.

lines.en: And the river had been rising since the weekend, so the flood should not have surprised anyone, honestly.
lines.pt: E o rio vinha subindo desde o fim de semana, então a enchente não deveria ter surpreendido ninguém.

lines.en: True. My neighbour had been saving money to repair his garage, but now the water has ruined everything inside.
lines.pt: Verdade. Meu vizinho vinha juntando dinheiro para consertar a garagem, mas agora a água estragou tudo lá dentro.

lines.en: That is awful. How long had you been living here when the last flood happened? I think it was before I moved in.
lines.pt: Isso é terrível. Há quanto tempo você morava aqui quando houve a última enchente? Acho que foi antes de eu me mudar.

lines.en: About two years. We had been working on the garden for months, and the mud destroyed the new plants in one night.
lines.pt: Uns dois anos. Vínhamos trabalhando no jardim havia meses, e a lama destruiu as plantas novas numa noite.

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. Were the volunteers helping you this morning? I saw a group with shovels near your gate.
lines.pt: Sinto muito. Os voluntários estavam ajudando você hoje de manhã? Vi um grupo com pás perto do seu portão.

lines.en: Yes, they had been cleaning the street since seven, and they refused any payment, which touched me.
lines.pt: Sim, eles vinham limpando a rua desde as sete e recusaram qualquer pagamento, o que me tocou.

lines.en: Good people. There is a meeting tonight at the school. We should ask why the warnings had been ignored for so long.
lines.pt: Boa gente. Há uma reunião hoje à noite na escola. Devemos perguntar por que os avisos foram ignorados por tanto tempo.

lines.en: I will go. If enough of us show up, the council will have to listen at last. I will bring the old reports.
lines.pt: Eu vou. Se bastante gente aparecer, a prefeitura terá de ouvir de uma vez. Levo os relatórios antigos.

facts.label: had been + -ing
facts.sub: Use para uma ação que vinha acontecendo antes de outro momento do passado: It had been raining for three days. Em português: “estava chovendo havia três dias”.

facts.label: for / since

items.s: Had been raining shows an action before another past moment.
We use had been + base verb.
For three days can follow had been raining.

answers: Had been raining shows an action before another past moment. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use had been + base verb. → Falso (We use had been + verb-ing.)
For three days can follow had been raining. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: After the flood · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey morning in Wellington. The street is covered in mud. Blake stands at his front gate. Ben walks over with a shovel. Wet carpets lie in the driveway. The neighbours talk about the flood.

“Ben, the water finally went down. It had been raining for three days before the street flooded last night.” says Blake. “I know. I had been checking the drain every hour, but it was already blocked with leaves and mud by midnight.” says Ben. “Experts had been warning us for years that the drains were too small. Nobody in the council took it seriously.” says Blake.
